Go module `github.com/bide-ai/bide`; [all packages](index.md).

`github.com/bide-ai/bide/model/provider` · [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bide-ai/bide/model/provider) · Stability: **core**

Package provider is the kit a model adapter is built from: HTTP error classification, SSE framing, a cap on a streamed reply, Retry-After parsing, and the tool-result codec.

**Constants**

- `const DefaultMaxResponseBytes = 32 << 20`: DefaultMaxResponseBytes is the most bytes of one streamed model reply an adapter reads unless it is configured otherwise (each adapter's WithMaxResponseBytes).
- `const MaxSSELine = 32 << 20`: MaxSSELine is the longest SSE line NewSSEScanner reads.

**Functions**

- `func ClassifyHTTPError(provider string, resp *http.Response) error`: ClassifyHTTPError turns a non-2xx model response into the appropriate SDK error.
- `func ClassifyStreamError(provider string, data []byte) error`: ClassifyStreamError turns an error object a provider sends inside a 200 stream (an OpenAI or Gemini data line holding {"error":{...}}, an Anthropic "error" event) into an SDK error.
- `func EncodeToolResultOr(c ToolResultCodec, raw json.RawMessage) string`: EncodeToolResultOr applies the codec to raw and returns the result.
- `func LimitResponse(body io.ReadCloser, max int64) io.ReadCloser`: LimitResponse returns body limited to max bytes (DefaultMaxResponseBytes when max &lt;= 0): once the reply has more, a read returns the bytes up to the limit and an error wrapping agent.ErrResponseTooLarge, which SSEReadError passes on.
- `func NewSSEScanner(body io.Reader) *bufio.Scanner`: NewSSEScanner returns a bufio.Scanner over an SSE stream body with the default 64KB line cap raised to MaxSSELine.
- `func ParseRetryAfter(s string) time.Duration`: ParseRetryAfter parses an HTTP Retry-After header value.
- `func SSEPayload(line string) (string, bool)`: SSEPayload extracts the data payload from one raw SSE line.
- `func SSEReadError(provider string, err error) error`: SSEReadError wraps a failed read of a model's SSE stream (the Err of a NewSSEScanner scanner) as an agent.ErrModel.

## type JSONToolResultCodec

```go
type JSONToolResultCodec struct{}
```

JSONToolResultCodec is the default codec: it passes the canonical JSON through unchanged.

**Methods**

- `func (JSONToolResultCodec) EncodeToolResult(raw json.RawMessage) (string, error)`: EncodeToolResult returns the JSON bytes as a string, unchanged.

## type ToolResultCodec

```go
type ToolResultCodec interface {
	EncodeToolResult(raw json.RawMessage) (string, error)
}
```

ToolResultCodec renders a tool result's canonical JSON bytes into the string content that is sent to the model.
